note: HLADRpos: HLA-DR-positive APCs — upper cluster (HLA-DR high) spanning a broad SSC-A range; the HLA-DR-low cluster at the lower-left is excluded. HLA-DR is bimodal — boundary set at the valley between the HLA-DR- and HLA-DR+ peaks.
tips: Enrich HLA-DR+ antigen-presenting cells within the CD14- CD16- CD56- compartment — the entry point to the DC branch. HLADRpos: HLA-DR+ (DCs are typically HLA-DR-high). Axis design caveat: x_marker is SSC-A, but this is a display / sanity-check axis to verify that events fall within the DC scatter range; the HLA-DR+ call is driven by HLA-DR on y.
